title: Huly connected cards
description: A pale band with an indented heading and a loose, scattered grid of near-black cards in three widths. Each card leads with a two-tone caption at the top and a glowing mock UI below: checklist, event, block menu, chat, voice call, project panel.
notes: the band follows the page's mode; the cards are always dark
widths sum per row to 12 on wide screens: e.g. four narrow, then wide + medium
